name: Earthworm
howToGet: Starting tackle and traders; no workbench recipe
description: The simplest bait in the game and the only one Snappers are listed for. The first contract is balanced around it, so buying fancy tackle early changes nothing.

name: Wind-Up Tin
howToGet: Craft at the workbench after researching Wind-Up Tin
description: A clicking tin of rotting meat that attracts small scavengers. The standard peaceful-fish lure and the correct answer for the three-Softgrazer contract.

name: Sturdy Earcrawler
howToGet: Craft at the workbench after researching Sturdy Earcrawler
description: A sound-emitting lure for peaceful fish that increases the chance of a trophy catch. Expensive to build — save it for class 3 hunting, not routine contracts.

name: Rainbow Fin
howToGet: Craft at the workbench after researching Rainbow Fin
description: A feathered lure that flutters when reeled, provoking predators into a chase. The workhorse predator bait and the key to the three-Harpooner contract.

name: Flaming Belly
howToGet: Craft at the workbench after researching Flaming Belly
description: A phosphorescent predator lure that mimics a wounded Snapper and increases trophy chance. A direct upgrade over Rainbow Fin once Jaws are spare.

name: Deadly Tick
howToGet: Craft at the workbench after spending 5 Torn Pages on Deadly Tick research
description: A spring-loaded predator bait with a trap-like trigger. A late-demo project: Sharpfin Flesh ties it to the level 50 peaceful catch, so plan the bait chain first.

name: Pipecross
howToGet: No workbench recipe in the demo data; treat it as a trader or exploration find
description: A heavy predator bait listed alongside Deadly Tick for the narrow predator group. The demo data gives it a price and unique rarity but no craft-table recipe.
